items.title: Companies and corporate groups
items.text: I keep the shareholder register, meetings and board of a company with many shareholders or of a corporate group.

items.title: Law firms and lawyers
items.text: I manage my clients' companies: their shareholder registers, their meetings and their minutes.

items.title: Scale-ups
items.text: We have several funding rounds, many investors and an incentive plan for the team.

items.title: Companies with many shareholders or investors
items.text: I want shareholders and investors to see their position, their documents and the meetings without having to ask me.

items.title: Funds, family offices and holdings
items.text: I invest in several companies and want to see the capital and documents of the investees in one place.
